input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (owner's standing ventures brief).
task: einvoice-preflight (flagship 5): Saxon route hands PINT/ZATCA/national-add-on files to the plain route

doc_friction.issue: 'every rule id ... has a specific English fix' only runs when ./schematron/ is built locally (CI never builds it), so upstream Peppol/XRechnung rule additions (PEPPOL-COMMON-R054..R057, DE-R-T02) went unnoticed until this run built the SEF files.
route without --task drew the research track although the scheduled brief is the ventures brief; the --task flag fixed it, but the routine prompt does not say to pass it.

notes: Picked the flagships.yaml item 'a 1.3.8 base on the Saxon route' and widened it: the Saxon runners (self-hosted ./browser/ page and runSchematron) checked every PINT, ZATCA, CIUS-RO, NLCIUS and CIUS-PT file against the current EU base alone. Measured with eval/saxon-plain-handoff.mjs on real built SEF (build-schematron.mjs, upstream default branches 2026-11-14): 95 fatal findings on 13 of 19 plain-only examples before (all 10 valid PINT/ZATCA examples failed), their own sets 0 on those 10; NLCIUS and CIUS-RO defects missed. Tests: node --test on saxon-plain-handoff/official-browser/schematron/cius-ro-base pass with and without ./schematron/ built; full run_venture_tests.py einvoice-preflight output in PR notes.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: trace two runners, design hand-off, build official SEF, measure 19 files, tests, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
